exposure: Fetal growth restriction status (Appropriate for Gestational Age - AGA, Small for Gestational Age - SGA)
outcome: Renal function parameters (Glomerular Filtration Rate - GFR, creatinine, BUN, BUN/Cr ratio, urinary output)
cohort: A cohort of 63 neonates, divided into gestational age groups (24-30 6/7 weeks, 31-36 6/7 weeks, and 37-42 weeks), with subgroups for appropriate for gestational age (AGA) and small for gestational age (SGA).
finding: Urinary Endothelin-1 (uET-1) levels did not correlate with plasma ET-1 levels but negatively correlated with gestational age and glomerular filtration rate (GFR), suggesting it may be a marker of impaired neonatal circulatory regulation and renal injury.
cross-section timing: At birth (cord blood) and 24 hours of life (blood/urine)
